$comment: Shown as plain text (works offline) when distress_flag comes back with reasonable probability. Edit freely for your region.
title: You don't have to carry this alone
body: It sounds like things might be really heavy right now. If you're in crisis or thinking about hurting yourself, talking to someone can help.

lines.label: Anywhere
lines.text: findahelpline.com lists free, confidential helplines by country

lines.label: Emergency
lines.text: If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number

note: Mote is a simple program and can misread things. If this doesn't fit, just close this card.
